name: Codium tomentosum extract
description: Codium tomentosum extract (CAS 223749-84-6 ) is a marine algae-derived ingredient sourced from green seaweed harvested in Atlantic coastal waters. It delivers moisturizing and antioxidant activity in cosmetic and nutritional formulations. The extract draws on a naturally rich profile of polysaccharides, amino acids, and micronutrients. In skincare formulations, it functions as a humectant and antioxidant active, incorporated into serums, creams, and masks. These products target hydration and environmental stress protection for the skin. Hair care manufacturers use it in conditioning treatments where marine-derived nutrients support scalp and fiber moisture retention. In nutrient-dense food and supplement products, it contributes bioavailable minerals and amino acids suited to functional food positioning. This versatility makes it a valuable addition to diverse product lines. Cosmetic formulators also use it as a stabilizing co-ingredient in emulsions where antioxidant support helps extend formulation integrity. It is typically supplied as a liquid extract or dried powder. Liquid forms are commonly standardized in aqueous or glycerin carrier bases. Grades available include cosmetic-grade and food-grade specifications, with the latter subject to relevant purity and contaminant standards. Buyers should confirm extract concentration, carrier composition, and origin certification when evaluating suppliers.
